name: Natlan's Nightsoul's Blessing
desc: A useful Natlanese mechanism for both exploration and combat that uses Nightsoul points and Phlogiston as its energy source.

customize.text: Adaptive Countermeasures

Adaptive Countermeasures are a core mechanic of Natlan's Secret Source Automaton enemies. This state is displayed in-game as a circular indicator next to their HP bar that fills when the enemy is attacked by, or is in proximity to, characters in the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
<color=#ffffffd9>Related Enemies</color>

customize.name: Secret Source Automaton: Hunter-Seeker
customize.desc:
An ancient ruin automaton used in object collection.
Legend has it that these ancient ruin machines were designed for specialized work functions, primarily conducting experimental work such as capturing and collecting samples, and had only basic combat functionality.
According to rumor, these were not built by humans, but are instead creations of a yet more ancient civilization. Today, that civilization has been lost, and all that remains are these strange machines that roam the land.

customize.text: When the indicator next to its HP bar fills, the automaton unleashes a powerful attack, but also enters a vulnerable state with significantly reduced RES.

customize.name: Secret Source Automaton: Configuration Device
customize.desc:
A manufacturing machine from the ancient ruins. This type of machine, which can transform into numerous shapes, was used by the masters of the ancient ruins to perform various manufacturing tasks. As long as you learn how to use such a machine, you could build a city colossal beyond imagination, even within extreme environments like the depths of a volcano.
In addition, it also seems to be able to be used as a weapon. Though the ancient civilization has long since fallen, this machine, shaped like a giant claw and powered by the golden designs engraved on it, can still engage in battle based upon its preset instructions.

customize.text: When the indicator next to its HP bar fills, the automaton activates its Accretion Mechanism, which creates two Solid Phlogiston pillars. Characters must climb the Solid Phlogiston (best done using abilities from the Children of Echoes) to destroy the Accretion Mechanism, putting the enemy in a vulnerable state.

customize.name: Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device
customize.desc:
A domination mechanism from the ancient ruins.
In ancient times, to oversee the operation of their mega-cities, a mighty race vested part of their power into a form of phlogiston-engineered intelligence. Driven by their mission, and by means of various other mechanisms, the machines upon which it was bestowed once controlled the functioning of myriad cities across the land. Now, long after their ancient civilization's fall through wars with an emerging race, these once-wise contraptions retain only the most basic of commands.

customize.text: During Sweeper Mode, the Automaton builds Adaptive Countermeasures when characters in Nightsoul's Blessing state are nearby. When the gauge is full and some Flow Momentum is already generated, it enters Counterstrike Mode, greatly lowering its RES and triggering periodic Hydro attacks on the player's position.
Void Ward

Void Ward is a shield mechanic unique to certain Natlan enemies.
Enemies protected by a Void Ward cannot take damage until the shield is fully depleted through Elemental attacks. Nightsoul-aligned DMG is especially effective at breaking the shield, with a single attack counting as three normal Elemental Attacks.
Alternatively, a way to deal with these shields without using Nightsoul-aligned characters is by relying on sources of very rapid Elemental application, such as the Burning reaction.
<color=#ffd780>Tutorial:</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>Related Enemies</color>

customize.name: Tenebrous Mimiflora
customize.desc:
Abyssal monsters that have descended to this world from the deep, dark depths of a twisted and alien world, they possess a plant-like appearance.
It is said that where the corrosive waves of the dark tide lap, such plant-like dark monsters will grow. But they only bear a superficial resemblance to plants, for it is a form they only adopted to get closer to the tree-like world, that they might extract the necessary concepts from it, and analyze and imitate them.
Some raving lunatics who have lost their minds say that those things that extend out like leaves are actually the beginnings of gates to other worlds.

customize.name: Tenebrous Papilla: Type I
customize.desc:
Abyssal creatures with plant-like forms that have descended from a deep, dark, unfathomable, contorted otherworld.
These twisted monstrosities are capable of infiltrating deep down into the bowels of the earth, extracting memories to imitate and manipulate. Through this process of distorting the past's memories into more abstruse and sordid forms, they gradually draw closer to Irminsul's core, threatening to undermine its very existence.
Some say that these aberrations work constantly to corrupt the many colors of light, leaving only pitch-black information in their stead. Such a hypothesis seems to be confirmed by the branches they extend outward, as if to pierce the void itself...

customize.name: Lord of Eroded Primal Fire
customize.desc:
A fell dragon, congealed from the power of pitch-black darkness.

A monster of the void, known as both the Reaper of the Abyss and "Gosoythoth." It is able to corrupt memories contained within the ley lines of the earth, congealing them into tangible forces of catastrophic portent. From these memories that since time immemorial have flowed below the land, it has managed to extract the remnant will of a primordial elemental dragon sovereign, drawing it out like marrow to repurpose as the foundation of its own fabricated image.

But is it truly a mere "image"? Brought back by the very otherworldly forces it had once resisted, a once-dead dragon opens its eyes anew, forsaking all in this brief dream of a resurrection. Trapped perpetually in the final day of its existence by this pitch-black gospel, its boundless fury has consumed all reason. Now, what remains is its unrelenting lust for battle, burning on without end.

customize.text: Overview

Nightsoul's Blessing State is a mechanism that Natlanese vision holders can use to increase their mobility and combat prowess. Nightsoul Points are used as its main resource to maintain the state. While in Natlan, Phlogiston can also be used to further lengthen its duration.
Nightsoul Points

Nightsoul Points is a resource unique to Natlanese characters. When a character is in their Nightsoul's Blessing State, the Nightsoul Points bar will appear. Nightsoul Points may be obtained by fulfilling conditions specific to each character.
Phlogiston

Phlogiston is a special high-temperature energy that can be found throughout Natlan. While in Natlan, the Phlogiston bar will appear above the HP bar. While the HP bar is unique to each character, the Phlogiston bar is shared between the characters in the party.
Natlanese characters may spend Phlogiston when using their talents, often to extend their Nightsoul's Blessing State once their Nightsoul Points have been depleted.
Combat Abilities

customize.name: Mualani
customize.desc: A well-known guide in Natlan who owns a watersports shop, and expert in all forms of wave-chasing.

customize.text:
Activation condition: use Elemental Skill
Mualani mounts her Sharky Surfboard, increasing her Movement SPD and interruption resistance.
Normal Attacks will be converted to Sharky's Bites, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Hydro DMG based on Mualani's Max HP. Sharky's Bites can be used in mid-air. DMG dealt this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
When Mualani makes contact with opponents in this state, she applies "Marked as Prey" to them and gains 1 Wave Momentum stack. Max 3 stacks, CD: 0.7s.
At 3 stacks, Sharky's Bite will be converted to Sharky's Surging Bite, further increasing her DMG and removing all her stacks when hitting an opponent.
When Sharky's Bite hits an opponent Marked as Prey, that mark will be removed, and she will fire Shark Missiles at up to 5 nearby opponents Marked as Prey, dealing DMG to them equal to this Sharky's Bite instance and clearing their Marks. If more than 1 opponent is the target of Sharky's Bite and Shark Missiles, the DMG dealt will decrease, decreasing at most to 72% of the original DMG when 3 opponents are targeted.
When Sharky's Surging Bite hits an opponent, a Puffer will be generated nearby. Mualani will restore 20 Nightsoul points when she picks up a Puffer. Only 2 can be created in this way during a single instance of being in Nightsoul's Blessing.

customize.name: Kachina
customize.desc: A young warrior of the Nanatzcayan, given the Ancient Name of "Uthabiti." Kind-hearted and insatiably persistent, she grows stronger and more capable with each setback she faces.

customize.text:
Activation condition: use Elemental Skill
Kachina casts Turbo Twirly:
When present independent of Kachina, it will slam the ground at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Geo DMG based on Kachina's DEF.
When Kachina is riding Turbo Twirly, she can control it to move and climb swiftly, and use Normal Attacks to slam the ground, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Geo DMG based on Kachina's DEF.

customize.name: Kinich
customize.desc: A Huitztlan Saurian Hunter skilled at counting costs.

customize.text:
Activation condition: use Elemental Skill
In this state, Kinich will hook onto a nearby opponent and perform a variable attack:
When using a Normal Attack, Kinich will fire Loop Shots as he loops around the grappled target based on his current movement direction, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Dendro DMG and generating 3 Nightsoul points. Loop Shot DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
When Nightsoul points are at max, he can use the Elemental Skill "Scalespiker Cannon": Consume all Nightsoul points to deal Nightsoul-aligned Dendro DMG. When "Scalespiker Cannon" is held, Kinich can aim this shot. After firing the Cannon, Kinich will try to grapple to its target.
While in Nightsoul's Blessing, after grappling an opponent or firing "Scalespiker Cannon," a Blind Spot will be generated next to the opponent. When Kinich enters this Blind Spot, it will disappear and he will generate 4 Nightsoul points.
If the grapple connection should snap due to exceeding the maximum distance or some other reason, using a Normal Attack will establish a new connection with a nearby opponent before performing Loop Shots.
Opponents hit by his Elemental Skill will enter the Desolation state, and when affected by Burning or Burgeon reaction DMG, they will restore 7 Nightsoul points to him. CD: 0.8s. The Desolation state will persist until this instance of Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.

customize.name: Xilonen
customize.desc: A Name Engraver of the Nanatzcayan, she is especially skilled at finding a good balance between the heavy responsibilities of her job and living well.

customize.text:
Activation condition: use Elemental Skill
Xilonen will enter the Blade Roller mode.
While in this mode, Xilonen's Normal Attacks will allow her to perform up to 4 kicks using her roller blades, and she will be unable to use Charged Attacks. Xilonen will deal Nightsoul-aligned Geo DMG based on her DEF that cannot be overridden.
Xilonen has 3 Samplers with her that can generate different Soundscapes based on her other party members' Elemental Types, that give different effects based on the team’s composition.

customize.name: Chasca
customize.desc: The Peacemaker of the Tlalocan, the ender of all disputes.

customize.text:
Activation condition: use Elemental Skill
Mounts "Soulsniper: Ritual Staff," increasing Chasca's Movement SPD and interruption resistance. In this state, Chasca will continually consume Nightsoul points to remain airborne. When sprinting or increasing height, extra Nightsoul points will be consumed. When using Normal or Charged Attacks, Tap or Hold to switch between using "Multitarget Fire" in different ways.
Multitarget Fire
Tap: Deal Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG to opponents in front. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
Hold: Enter Aiming Mode and choose a certain number of opponents within a certain range, before loading up to 6 Shadowhunt Shells based on the duration for which the skill was charged. When 6 Shells have been loaded or charging is stopped, these Shells will be fired at the chosen opponents in sequence. The Shells are considered Nightsoul-aligned Anemo Charged Attack DMG, and the 4th, 5th and 6th will undergo Elemental Conversion based on the Elemental Types of the other characters in the party. For each Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro character in the party, one Shadowhunt Shell will randomly be Converted into a "Shining Shadowhunt Shell" of one of these corresponding Elemental Types, dealing Nightsoul-aligned DMG corresponding to that Elemental Type. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.

customize.name: Ororon
customize.desc: A young man from the Masters of the Night-Wind who instead lives in the wild alongside all manner of life.

customize.text:
Activation condition: nearby opponents take Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged reaction DMG or Nightsoul-aligned DMG dealt by other nearby characters
Ororon will consume 10 Nightsoul points (provided he has at least that amount), entering the Nightsoul's Blessing state and triggering the Hypersense effect: Deal Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG based on 160% of Ororon's ATK to at most 4 nearby opponents. CD: 1.8s.

customize.name: Mavuika
customize.desc: The leader of Natlan who inherited the Ancient Name of "Kiongozi." She made a vow to illuminate the future of the nation of war with the Sacred Flame.

customize.text:
Activation condition: Use Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points according to the All-Fire Armaments' form:
"Divine Name Unleashed": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Ring of Searing Radiance. The Ring follows the current active character and attacks nearby opponents at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG.
"Ancient Name Unbound": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Flamestrider. In this state, Mavuika can ride the Flamestrider at high speed, or activate its hidden backup propulsion module to temporarily cross various terrain types and glide in mid-air. Mavuika's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will also be converted to deal Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG which cannot be overridden. When sprinting, she also deals Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG to opponents along her path.
While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, tapping the Elemental Skill can switch the All-Fire Armaments' form. The Armaments will disappear once Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.
Mavuika's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Energy, but instead on "Fighting Spirit", and one way to charge it is by consuming Nightsoul Points.

customize.name: Citlali
customize.desc: The great shaman from the Masters of the Night-Wind, the universally-revered Granny Itztli.

customize.text:
Activation condition: Use Elemental Skill
Summons Itzpapa:
Itzpapa will follow the character.
If Citlali has at least 50 Nightsoul points, Itzpapa enters the Opal Fire state and continuously consumes Nightsoul points to whip up a Frostfall Storm that follows the character and attacks opponents within its AoE, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG.
When Citlali's Nightsoul points are fully depleted, Itzpapa's Opal Fire state also ends.

customize.name: Traveler (Pyro)
customize.desc: A traveler from another world who had their only kin taken away, forcing them to embark on a journey to find The Seven.

customize.text:
Activation condition: Tap or Hold Elemental Skill
Tap: summons a Blazing Treshold that deals Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG at intervals when close to opponents.
Hold: summons a Scorching Treshold that deals Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG when the currently active character hits an opponent (CD:3s).

customize.name: Varesa
customize.desc: A laid-back orchard manager and warrior of the Collective of Plenty. An aspiring hero who hungers for justice... and lots and lots of food!

customize.text:
Activation condition: Hold Elemental Skill (Sudden Onrush state) or reach maximum Nightsoul Points (Fiery Passion state)
Sudden Onrush: Movement SPD and interruption resistance are increased.
Fiery Passion: her Normal Attacks, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst will gain unique buffs. She can also use a special Elemental Burst shortly after using a Plunging Attack.
When not in Fiery Passion state, Varesa can use Plunging Attacks and Elemental Burst to restore Nightsoul Points.

customize.name: Iansan
customize.desc: Head coach of the fitness club at the Collective of Plenty, and a renowned Natlanese nutritionist.

customize.text:
Activation condition: use Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst
Iansan's Charged Attack will be transformed into a Swift Stormflight, consuming a certain amount of Stamina to stomp fiercely down, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG.
Doing a Normal Attack within 5s of using Elemental Skill will make Iansan use Swift Stormflight without consuming Stamina.
When using Elemental Burst, summons a Kinetic Energy Scale, which gives an ATK% buff to the active character based on Iansan’s ATK% and/or amount of Nightsoul Points, based on specific conditions.

customize.name: Ifa
customize.desc: A vet from the Flower-Feather Clan who cherishes the life he leads alongside all manner of living things — people, animals, you name it.

customize.text:
Activation condition: use Elemental Skill
Ifa will hover in the air with Cacucu's help.
When he uses Normal Attacks in this state, he will use different kinds of Supporting Fire depending on whether you Tap or Hold, firing Tonicshots that are capable of healing all party members.
Every 1 Nightsoul point out of the total in his entire party will grant him 1 Rescue Essentials point. Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged DMG dealt by nearby party members.

Overview

Nightsoul Burst is a mechanism that is activated when any character deals Elemental DMG to an enemy while the party contains a Natlanese character. It is depicted by a visual effect.
For every Natlanese character in the party up to 3, the CD of Nightsoul Burst is reduced. For 1/2/3 or more Natlanese characters, the CD between Nightsoul Bursts will be 18/12/9s respectively.
This mechanism is used to trigger certain effects such as Character Talent and Artifact effects.
Additionally, similar effects to Nightsoul Burst can be triggered in other ways.
Xilonen - Triggers an effect equal to her Nightsoul Burst when her Nightsoul Points reach the maximum. It has a 14s CD.

Overview

Nightsoul Transmission is a mechanism that triggers when the active character is performing an action such as sprinting, swimming, etc. It allows the player to fluidly change to a Natlanese character and enter their Nightsoul's Blessing State immediately. It has a 10s Cooldown, which is shared between all Natlanese characters in the party. Depending on the character, if required, a small amount of Nightsoul Points is also given to maintain the state.
This is a pseudo-state and is separate from the normal Nightsoul's Blessing State. At any time, players can enter the Nightsoul's Blessing State using Elemental Skill. However, the remaining Nightsoul Points from Nightsoul Transmission will not be recovered or used to extend the state.

imgDesc.text: The Nightsoul's Blessing state that characters from Natlan can engage will usually increase their mobility and combat prowess. For most characters, their Elemental Skills are the most convenient way of entering this state.

Nightsoul's Blessings are usually closely related to the resource known as Nightsoul points. For example, Kachina will consume these points to ride Turbo Twirly or attack using it, and when the points run out, the Nightsoul's Blessing state will end and Turbo Twirly will disappear.
